reading.a: An evening crowd of about twenty people stands behind a chain-link fence in front of a white brick wall carrying an air-conditioner, two large wooden cart wheels, a Ukrainian flag and a painted green-hills mural.
reading.b: A daytime lounge under a hanging-stick ceiling (element 1): eight shirtless men on green sofas in front, two paintings on a dark wall at the left, and a glass wall at the right looking onto pine trunks, a building and green foliage.

concepts.idea: The camera pulls back out of the bar crowd until it stands outside the lounge's glass wall, with B's ceiling, dark wall and seated men entering over it as in rounds 8 and 9 and the ceiling now always in front; once the pane reads as a pane (t 0.3), the brick wall, wheels and flag above the crowd become pines, foliage and sky while the crowd and the fence stay (reached at t 0.6), then the crowd's half of the pane becomes B's view below the trees (t 0.6-0.85), and the last of A in the glass gives way brightest-first (t 0.85-1.0).

anchors.how: Unchanged from rounds 8 and 9: A's whole frame goes onto the quad in the glass wall's plane, every edge of A behind a B occluder.

transforms.name: pane_becomes_view
transforms.note: The one beat: the view through the pane turns from A's bar into B's garden through one generated in-between (A's crowd and fence kept, the wall and upper half already B's pines and sky). Answers 'still crossfades': the in-between now exists as a picture, so the middle frames are a morph between neighbours, not A and B at half strength. Answers 'wheels on the wal of A tranform into sky , weird': the wheels morph is dropped, and no element of A is morphed on its own (the crowd included). The keyframe is reached at chain progress 0.55, clip t 0.60; the window starts at 0.3, when the pull-back shows the pane as a pane, and ends at 0.85, before the end effect.

helper.what: One generated picture of the view through the pane in A's frame: the upper half (brick wall, wheels, flag, air-conditioner) replaced by B's pines, building and sky; A's crowd and fence kept person for person, with two small changes (one V sign became a closed hand, one woman gained sunglasses); everything outside the pane and both end frames stay original.

knobs.name: front_ids
knobs.what: B elements forced into the front layer; the ceiling (element 1) is his 'should have been in foreground'; add an element here if another B occluder is still covered by the pane.

knobs.name: pane_becomes_view.params.times[0]
knobs.what: When in the chain the keyframe is reached; earlier gives the keyframe-to-B segment (the crowd leaving) more time.

knobs.name: pullback.parallax.gain_A
knobs.what: How far A's crowd moves against its wall during the pull-back; lower it if the depth remap tears the crowd's outline against the generated trees.

concepts.risk: F1 double exposure: the keyframe keeps A's crowd, so its second segment (keyframe to B, t 0.6-0.85) carries the crowd into B's lower view by flow and a linear mix; there is no picture of the crowd leaving, so watch t 0.65-0.8 for half-strength people over the lawn and sofas (the 'some people and furniture' he named). F3 invention: the keyframe changed one hand gesture and added one pair of sunglasses; both are inside the crowd that leaves in the second segment, and the page must say the keyframe is generated. F2 decoration: if the depth remap at gain_A 0.8 moves A's crowd while the keyframe's crowd sits still, the first segment's flow sees two crowds a few px apart and smears faces at t 0.4-0.6.
